messages:
Ben (Support): Escalating from Support — KelpPay trial hitting sporadic inference latency spikes in eu-west-1 and sporadic 429 embed quota errors. Renewal in ~6 weeks, customer worried. Requesting CS takeover for comms + renewal risk assessment.
Maria (CS): Ack — assigning owner. Can you paste the most recent error logs and top affected routes?
Ben (Support): Logs attached, sample: ```ERROR 2026-02-10T14:02:11Z inference: request failed status=504 model=redwood-small eu-west-1; user=kotlin-team; route=/chat/generate
RateLimiter: quota_exceeded embed: user_id=kelppay-org limit=500/day current=543```
Ben (Support): Top impacted routes: /chat/generate (90%), /embeddings/create (10%). Traffic spike started yesterday evening after a large ingest job.
Raj (SE): Possible quick mitigations: 1) Route KelpPay to us-central-1 model variant temporarily, 2) enable prefix KV cache for their common prompts, 3) reduce batch_size to 8 for chat. Example route override: ```routes:
  - id: kelppay-override
    match: org:kelppay
    region: us-central-1
    model: redwood-small-v2-fp16
    batch_size: 8
    kv_cache: true```
Elaine (CS Manager): Good. Maria, can you draft a comms plan (who, what, when) and a short customer-facing script? We should also score renewal risk and offer an enablement slot.
Jordan (PM): If this becomes renewal risk, we can offer a 2-week term extension and free Dedicated trials for predictable throughput. Coordinate with sales.
Maria (CS): Draft comms plan: - Owner: Maria (CS) + Raj for SE changes - Audience: KelpPay technical + procurement leads - Message: transparent incident + immediate mitigations + ETA for long-term fix - Timing: initial touch within 2 hrs, technical call within 24 hrs - Ask: permission to failover region for short window - Risk: HIGH (renewal <8w)
Maria (CS): Quick customer script (short): "Hi Sam — thanks for flagging. We're seeing an ingest-driven spike affecting your EU region. Immediate mitigation is to route traffic to an alternate region and enable caching while we stabilize. Can we schedule a 30-min technical call in the next 24 hours? We'll hold your renewal decision off until it's resolved."
Ben (Support): Support will roll the region override now for a subset (10% traffic) and watch. Notifying ops to throttle ingest job.
Raj (SE): I'll prepare the route change and a small runbook for rollback. Also scheduling an enablement to show KV cache + prompt patterns. Proposed times: Tue 10:00 or Wed 16:00 CET — which works?
Elaine (CS Manager): Schedule Tue 10:00 CET. Maria, can you prepare a short enablement agenda and send calendar invite to KelpPay + internal renewal owner? Jordan will join if renewal talk is needed.
Maria (CS): Draft agenda: 1) Quick incident summary (5m) 2) Live mitigation status (5m) 3) Walkthrough: KV caching & routing (15m) 4) Q&A & next steps (5m). I'll send invite + follow-up email template.
Ben (Support): Confirmed: 10% traffic routed; latency for that cohort down ~40% in first 20m. Will expand to 50% if stable.
sre-bot: [alert] monitoring.kelp-pay.eu-west-1 latency spike page: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/3281 (auto-updated)
Maria (CS): Comms email template (internal): "Subject: KelpPay — EU latency & temporary mitigation
Hi Sam + team, we observed an ingest-driven spike impacting your EU region. We've initiated a staged failover to us-central-1 and enabled caching. Next: (1) 30-min technical call Tue 10:00 CET, (2) we'll pause renewal decision until stability confirmed, (3) we'll send a short survey after the call to capture feedback. Owner: Maria (CS)."
Jordan (PM): I'll prep renewal options and a short commercial note to include if stabilization takes >72h.
Elaine (CS Manager): Action items: - Ben: expand routing if stable (owner: Ben) - Raj: runbook + enablement slides (owner: Raj) - Maria: invite + comms + renewal signal to sales (owner: Maria) - Jordan: prep commercial fallback (owner: Jordan)
Maria (CS): Noted. We'll capture customer feedback via 3-question pulse after the call: satisfaction (1-5), clarity of fix (yes/no), further asks (free text).
Ben (Support): I'll update the support ticket and mark escalated->CS.
Maria (CS): Thanks team — I'll lead the customer touch and keep this thread updated. If anything degrades, ping @elaine. :thumbsup:
